sources.entry: PDF Reader Pro - You Can view, create, sign, convert and compress any PDF documents. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pdf-reader-pro-your-pdf-office/id825459243?platform=mac)

summary.name: PDF Reader Pro
summary.one_liner: PDF Reader Pro is a commercial PDF application for Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android that handles viewing, annotating, editing, converting, signing, organizing, and securing PDFs, with AI features.
use_cases: Annotating and highlighting documents for grading or review
Merging files into a single PDF collection
Converting drawings or documents to PDF
Adding passwords and watermarks to sensitive PDFs
Summarizing or translating PDF content with AI
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PDF Reader Pro as a PDF suite covering fill and sign, OCR, edit, convert, organize, read, annotate, and secure tools. It advertises AI features that integrate ChatGPT and DeepSeek (including DeepThink mode) for translating, summarizing, rewriting, and proofreading PDF content. Users can merge files, add watermarks, and set PDF passwords. The page also mentions online browser-based PDF tools that need no download. The listing on awesome-mac says it can view, create, sign, convert, and compress PDFs, and links to a Mac App Store version.
notable: Integrates ChatGPT and DeepSeek R1 for AI document processing
Educational discount of 50% off for teachers and students
Online browser-based PDF tools with no download needed
caveats: Described as premium software; the page does not list specific prices
Free trial is offered ("Try It Free") but the page does not state its limits
Minimum OS requirements apply: macOS 11.0+, Windows 7+, iOS 13.0+, Android 7.0+
